lines.text: Many learners say: You are a teacher, isn't it?
Better: You are a teacher, aren't you?
After You are, end with aren't you.
Aren't you! You are happy, aren't you?

native.tip: Kita sering menutup semua kalimat dengan “kan”. Dalam bahasa Inggris akhirannya harus cocok: You are → aren't you.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “You are a teacher, isn't it?” 😅 Akhirannya harus cocok dengan kalimatnya, jadi pakai aren't you: “You are a teacher, aren't you?” Dengarkan Kak Carlos, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “aren't you”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “You are a teacher, aren't you?” lalu tulis satu kalimat dengan aren't you. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We end any sentence with “kan”. In English the ending must match: You are → aren't you.
en.caption: Ever say this? “You are a teacher, isn't it?” 😅 The ending must match, so use aren't you: “You are a teacher, aren't you?” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
